title: Canadian Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with tender beef and fresh cabbage. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth, potatoes, carrots, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the flour to thicken the stew.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
